questions.subject: Biology
questions.q: Which hormone is primarily responsible for lowering blood glucose levels by promoting cellular uptake of glucose?
questions.e: Insulin, secreted by pancreatic beta cells, lowers blood glucose by facilitating glucose uptake into cells and promoting glycogenesis. Glucagon, adrenaline and cortisol raise blood glucose.

questions.subject: Biology
questions.q: The 'powerhouse of the cell' that generates ATP through oxidative phosphorylation is the:
questions.e: Mitochondria carry out aerobic respiration: the electron transport chain and ATP synthase on the inner mitochondrial membrane produce ATP via oxidative phosphorylation.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.q: The dimensional formula of force is:
questions.e: Force = mass × acceleration = M × LT-2 = [MLT-2].

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q: The pH of a 0.01 M HCl solution at 25°C is:
questions.e: HCl is a strong acid: [H+] = 0.01 M = 10-2 M, so pH = -log(10-2) = 2.

questions.subject: Biology
questions.q: Which organelle is known as the 'powerhouse of the cell'?
questions.e: Mitochondria — they carry out aerobic respiration, producing ATP, the cell's energy currency.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.q: The SI unit of power is the:
questions.e: Watt — 1 W = 1 joule per second.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q: The most abundant gas in Earth's atmosphere is:
questions.e: Nitrogen (~78%), followed by oxygen (~21%).

questions.subject: Biology
questions.q: The structural and functional unit of the kidney is the:
questions.e: The nephron — each kidney has about a million nephrons; the glomerulus is only part of one.

questions.subject: Current affairs
questions.q: What two-tier structure did a parliamentary committee propose for NEET-UG in its October 2026 report?
o: A state test followed by a national test
A common preliminary test followed by course-specific mains
A written test followed by an interview
A school-board test followed by a counselling test
questions.e: The Parliamentary Committee on Education, Women, Children, Youth and Sports proposed splitting NEET-UG into a common preliminary screening test for all medical aspirants and course-specific mains, drawing a parallel with the Civil Services Examination. This is a recommendation, not a notified change.

questions.subject: Human Physiology
questions.q: Which of the following is the correct sequence of events during transmission of a nerve impulse across a chemical synapse?
o: Neurotransmitter release → receptor binding → action potential in postsynaptic neuron
Action potential in postsynaptic neuron → neurotransmitter release → receptor binding
Receptor binding → neurotransmitter release → action potential
Neurotransmitter synthesis → action potential → receptor binding
questions.e: An arriving action potential triggers neurotransmitter release into the synaptic cleft; binding to postsynaptic receptors then generates a postsynaptic potential.

questions.subject: Genetics
questions.q: In a DNA double helix, the two strands are antiparallel. Which base-pairing rule holds throughout?
o: A pairs with G, T pairs with C
A pairs with T, G pairs with C
A pairs with C, G pairs with T
A pairs with U, G pairs with C
questions.e: Chargaff's rule: adenine pairs with thymine (two hydrogen bonds) and guanine pairs with cytosine (three hydrogen bonds).

questions.subject: Plant Physiology
questions.q: In C4 plants, the first stable product of carbon fixation is:
questions.e: In C4 plants, PEP carboxylase fixes CO2 into oxaloacetate (a 4-carbon compound) in mesophyll cells; the Calvin cycle then runs in bundle-sheath cells.

questions.subject: Exam Updates
questions.q: The NTA's planned AI-powered helpline for entrance-exam candidates, reported in October 2026, is intended to help with which of the following?
o: Registration, form filling, documents, fee submission, eligibility and exam procedure
questions.e: The AI helpline, being tested on the repurposed toll-free number 1800 180 47 47, is designed to give instant assistance on registration, form filling, documents, fee submission, eligibility and examination procedure for NTA exams such as JEE Main and NEET UG.

questions.subject: Biology
questions.q: Which protein is the light-controlled switch at the heart of optogenetics?
o: Rhodopsin in the human retina only
Channelrhodopsin, a light-gated ion channel from an alga
questions.e: Channelrhodopsin, discovered in a single-celled alga, acts as a light-controlled switch: light opens the ion channel and changes the activity of the nerve cell carrying it.

questions.subject: Biology
questions.q: Who won the 2026 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine?
o: Karl Deisseroth, Peter Hegemann and Georg Nagel
Henri B. Kagan and Kenso Soai
questions.e: The 2026 Medicine Nobel went to Karl Deisseroth, Peter Hegemann and Georg Nagel for light-gated ion channels and optogenetics; the Physics prize went to Francis Halzen for the IceCube Neutrino Observatory.

questions.subject: Biology
questions.q: The 2026 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine recognised discoveries concerning light-gated ion channels and optogenetics. What does optogenetics allow researchers to do?
o: Use light-sensitive proteins to control and investigate cellular activity, especially in nerve cells
Image tumours using fluorescent dyes only
questions.e: Light-gated ion channels open in response to light, letting researchers switch nerve cells on or off with precise timing - a tool now central to neuroscience.

questions.subject: Biology
questions.q: Who shared the 2026 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine?
o: Karl Deisseroth, Peter Hegemann and Georg Nagel
questions.e: The prize was announced on 5 October 2026 by the Nobel Assembly at Karolinska Institutet.

questions.subject: Current affairs
questions.q: What is the confirmed position on the NEET UG 2027 examination date as of 26 October 2026?
o: NTA has not announced it; dates circulating online are guesses
It will follow the JEE Main Session 1 dates
questions.e: NTA's revised calendar of 26 October 2026 lists JEE Main, UGC NET, CUET PG and other tests but not NEET UG; the detailed bulletin will come separately on neet.nta.nic.in.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q: In the Soai reaction, recognised by the 2026 Chemistry Nobel, what does the chiral product do?
o: It catalyses its own formation, amplifying enantiomeric excess
questions.e: This autocatalytic amplification is why the Soai reaction matters for understanding the origin of biological homochirality - life's preference for one mirror-image form.

questions.subject: Exam strategy
questions.q: As per NTA's revised calendar of 26 October 2026, which statement about NEET UG 2027 is correct?
o: Its date was announced in the revised calendar
NTA said it had not announced the NEET UG date yet in that calendar
It will be held in January 2027
It was merged with CUET PG
questions.e: NTA's revised calendar of 26 October 2026 covered UGC NET, CSIR-UGC NET, JEE Main and CUET PG, and NTA stated it had not announced the NEET UG date yet; candidates should rely only on nta.ac.in and neet.nta.nic.in.

questions.subject: Biology
questions.q: Which of the following is the correct pairing for a biodiversity access-and-benefit-sharing (ABS) example?
o: ABS money is shared with State Biodiversity Boards when genetic resources are commercially used
ABS applies only to marine fisheries
ABS is a tax on farmers
ABS replaces the Biological Diversity Act
questions.e: Under the ABS framework, benefits from using biological resources are shared with custodians; in October 2026 the National Biodiversity Authority disbursed about ₹1.04 crore of ABS money to 27 State Biodiversity Boards and two UT councils, with Uttar Pradesh the top recipient.

questions.subject: Zoology
questions.q: The 2026 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine recognised discoveries about light-gated ion channels and optogenetics. The light-sensitive protein at the heart of the work, channelrhodopsin, was discovered in:
questions.e: Channelrhodopsin, found in a single-celled alga, acts as a light-controlled switch for nerve cells — the basis of optogenetics, recognised in the 2026 Medicine Nobel to Deisseroth, Hegemann and Nagel.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q: The 2026 Nobel Prize in Chemistry, to Henri B. Kagan and Kenso Soai, recognised non-linear effects and autocatalysis in:
questions.e: Kagan and Soai were recognised for non-linear effects and autocatalysis in asymmetric organic synthesis — chemistry that favours one mirror-image form of a molecule over the other.

questions.subject: Biology
questions.q: The NPPA cap announced in October 2026 covers how many anti-cancer drugs?
questions.e: The National Pharmaceutical Pricing Authority capped the trade margin at 30% of MRP for 137 anti-cancer drugs, effective 9 November 2026.

questions.subject: Counselling
questions.q: The UP NEET UG 2026 Round 3 counselling schedule, released on 27 October 2026, sets online registration and choice filling as:
o: Registration 28 October only; choice filling 2 November
questions.e: Registration runs from 26 October (5 pm) to 28 October (2 pm), the merit list is declared on 28 October, choice filling runs from 28 October (5 pm) to 31 October (5 pm), and the allotment result is declared on 2 November 2026.

questions.subject: Counselling
questions.q: On 13 October 2026 the Medical Counselling Committee clarified that a notice claiming a reduction in the NEET UG 2026 counselling cut-off percentile was:
o: Fake; no such decision had been taken by the competent authority
Genuine; the percentile was cut to the 15th percentile
questions.e: MCC's notice of 13 October 2026 (U-11011/07/2026-MEC) said no decision on percentile reduction had been taken and the circulating notice was fake; MCC hosts no website other than mcc.nic.in.

questions.subject: Biology
questions.q: The MCC directed state counselling authorities to exclude candidates who had already joined All India Quota seats up to Round 3 before processing state Round 3, following Supreme Court directions in:
o: Shubhankar Patnaik v. K. Ramesh Reddy (Contempt Petition No. 289 of 2022)
Kishan Chand Jain v. Ethics and Medical Registration Board
questions.e: MCC said filtering out joined AIQ candidates is mandatory before the stray vacancy round of state UG counselling, as per the Supreme Court's directions in Shubhankar Patnaik v. K. Ramesh Reddy.

questions.subject: Biology
questions.q: The Supreme Court hearing of 27 October 2026 on medicine prices recorded that the Centre had capped the trade margin on cancer drugs at 30% of MRP. Which authority fixes such price controls in India?
questions.e: The NPPA caps trade margins under the Drug Price Control Order; the Court heard that 137 anti-cancer drugs were covered by the 30%-of-MRP cap effective 9 November 2026.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q: The 2026 Nobel Prize in Chemistry recognised work on non-linear effects and autocatalysis in asymmetric organic synthesis. In the Soai reaction, a small initial excess of one enantiomer is amplified because the product does what?
o: It catalyses its own formation, favouring its own mirror-image form
It racemises the mixture to a 50:50 ratio
questions.e: Henri Kagan and Kenso Soai were awarded the prize on 7 October 2026. Their work helps explain how homochirality — the dominance of one mirror-image form in living things — can emerge spontaneously, and it matters for making single-enantiomer drugs.

questions.subject: Zoology
questions.q: The Arabian Black Electric Ray, Tetronarce ramanamurthyi, described in October 2026, belongs to which family of cartilaginous fishes known for generating electric shocks?
questions.e: The species was identified from nine specimens collected at 400-700 metres depth off India's south-western coast. It has a disc wider than it is long, relatively small kidney-shaped electric organs, and no fleshy projections around the spiracles.

questions.subject: Biology
questions.q: Why is the description of Tetronarce ramanamurthyi significant for Indian Ocean biogeography?
o: It is the first confirmed record of the genus Tetronarce in the northern Indian Ocean
It is the first ray recorded in the Arabian Sea
It is the largest fish in the Indian Ocean
It is the first freshwater electric ray
questions.e: The discovery, published in Zootaxa and made under the Deep Ocean Mission, came from fish-landing surveys at Sakthikulangara Fishing Harbour, Kerala, where the rays were bycatch from deep-sea trawling for red shrimps. Genetic analysis using COI and ND2 genes showed 2.2%-6.7% divergence from related species.

questions.subject: Biology
questions.q: Tetronarce ramanamurthyi, reported on 27 October 2026, belongs to which group and was distinguished from relatives by anatomy and DNA sequencing showing what divergence range?
questions.e: Nine specimens from the south-eastern Arabian Sea, collected under the Deep Ocean Mission, established the first confirmed Tetronarce record in the northern Indian Ocean.

questions.subject: Biology
questions.q: India cited 1,134 Protected Areas and 103 Ramsar sites at CBD COP-17. A Ramsar site is designated under a convention concerned primarily with:
questions.e: The Ramsar Convention (1971) covers wetlands; India also cited 57 Biodiversity Heritage Sites and 18 Biosphere Reserves.

questions.subject: Biology
questions.q: The Kunming-Montreal Global Biodiversity Framework, whose implementation was discussed at COP-17, was adopted in 2022 with the goal of halting and reversing biodiversity loss by which year?
questions.e: The framework has four goals for 2050 and 23 targets for 2030; COP-17 in Yerevan is the first global review of progress.

questions.subject: Biology
questions.q: Electric organs in electric rays such as Tetronarce are modified from which tissue?
o: Skeletal muscle / electrocytes derived from muscle
questions.e: Electric organs consist of electrocytes, modified muscle cells arranged in series that generate electric discharges; the new species was noted to have relatively small electric organs.

questions.subject: Biology
questions.q: The Deep Ocean Mission, under which the new electric ray specimens were collected, is administered by which ministry?
o: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change
Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways
questions.e: Reports identify the Deep Ocean Mission as a Ministry of Earth Sciences programme; the species honours its mission director, M. V. Ramana Murthy.

questions.subject: Biology
questions.q: The 2026 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine recognised discoveries concerning light-sensitive ion channels and optogenetics. Who were the laureates?
o: Karl Deisseroth, Peter Hegemann and Georg Nagel
Svante Paabo, David Julius and Ardem Patapoutian
questions.e: The 2026 Medicine prize, announced 5 October 2026, went to Karl Deisseroth, Peter Hegemann and Georg Nagel for discoveries concerning light-gated ion channels that made optogenetics possible.

questions.subject: Biology
questions.q: In a monohybrid cross between two heterozygous tall pea plants (Tt x Tt), what is the expected phenotypic ratio in the offspring?
questions.e: Tt x Tt gives genotypes TT, Tt, Tt, tt, so the phenotypic ratio of tall to dwarf is 3:1, while the genotypic ratio is 1:2:1.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q: What is the pH of a 0.01 M aqueous solution of hydrochloric acid (a strong acid, fully dissociated) at 25 C?

questions.subject: Zoology
questions.q: The 2026 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine was awarded to Karl Deisseroth, Peter Hegemann and Georg Nagel for discoveries enabling optogenetics. Optogenetics allows scientists to control nerve cells by using:
o: Light acting on light-gated ion channels
questions.e: Optogenetics inserts light-gated ion channels into nerve cells, which can then be switched on or off with light, letting researchers trigger or silence chosen cells in living brains and map circuits behind behaviour and disease.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q: Henri Kagan and Kenso Soai won the 2026 Nobel Prize in Chemistry for work on autocatalysis and homochirality. In an autocatalytic reaction, the product:
o: Catalyses its own formation, amplifying one mirror-image form
questions.e: Their reactions showed how a small initial imbalance between mirror-image (enantiomer) forms can be amplified: the product catalyses formation of more of itself. Kagan developed a reaction method in 1986; Soai described the approach in 1995 and produced one mirror-image variant in 2003.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.q: The IceCube Neutrino Observatory, associated with the 2026 Nobel Prize in Physics for neutrino astronomy, detects neutrinos through:
o: Cherenkov radiation in Antarctic glacial ice
questions.e: When neutrinos interact in the ice, the fast charged particles produced emit Cherenkov radiation, which IceCube's optical sensors detect deep in Antarctic glacial ice.

questions.subject: Botany
questions.q: Green hydrogen is produced by electrolysis of water using renewable electricity. The electrolysis of water yields hydrogen and which other gas?
questions.e: Electrolysis splits water (H2O) into hydrogen at the cathode and oxygen at the anode. India's National Green Hydrogen Mission targets at least 5 million metric tonnes of annual green hydrogen production by 2030.

questions.subject: Biology
questions.q: During Cyclone Arnab, hospitals in Andhra Pradesh recorded 367 deliveries among 3,100 pregnant women shifted to facilities before landfall. Which hormone is primarily responsible for initiating uterine contractions during labour?
questions.e: Oxytocin, released from the posterior pituitary, stimulates uterine contractions and shows positive feedback during labour. Progesterone maintains pregnancy, prolactin supports lactation, and relaxin softens pelvic ligaments.

questions.subject: Biology
questions.q: After flood events such as the 2026 Sankosh flood alert, the risk of water-borne disease rises mainly because floodwater:
o: Mixes with sewage and contaminants, spreading pathogens
questions.e: Floodwater mixes with sewage, animal waste and debris, spreading bacteria, viruses and parasites that cause cholera, typhoid, hepatitis A and diarrhoeal disease. Public-health response stresses safe drinking water, chlorination, sanitation and surveillance after floods.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q: NVS-03 carries an indigenous rubidium atomic clock. Rubidium belongs to which group of the periodic table?
questions.e: Rubidium (Rb, atomic number 37) is a Group 1 alkali metal. Rubidium atomic clocks use the hyperfine transition of rubidium-87 atoms as a highly stable frequency standard for satellite navigation timing.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.q: NavIC's NVS-03 adds the L1 signal alongside L5 and S-band signals. In satellite navigation, adding more signal frequencies primarily helps receivers to:
o: Correct ionospheric delay and improve positioning accuracy
Avoid the need for atomic clocks
questions.e: Multi-frequency signals allow receivers to estimate and correct ionospheric delay, which differs with frequency, improving accuracy and reliability. The L1 signal also improves compatibility with mass-market receivers already designed for L1-based systems.

questions.subject: Current affairs
questions.q: The parliamentary committee report on NTA reforms (October 2026) proposed a two-stage NEET-UG: a common preliminary followed by specialised mains. What was the stated purpose of separating the streams?
o: To reduce avoidable competition between candidates seeking MBBS, nursing and AYUSH seats
To increase the number of exam centres
questions.e: The committee noted NEET-UG remains a single-stage test for over 22 lakh candidates across MBBS, BDS, nursing and AYUSH admissions.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.q: NVS-03 carries an indigenous rubidium atomic clock. Atomic clocks keep time by counting oscillations associated with transitions between energy levels of atoms; rubidium clocks commonly use which type of transition?
questions.e: Precise atomic clocks are essential for satellite navigation: a timing error of one nanosecond corresponds to about 30 cm of positioning error.

questions.subject: Current affairs
questions.q: As of 20 October 2026, had the NTA announced the NEET-UG 2027 exam date?
o: No, it had not been announced
questions.e: The NTA calendar up to March 2027 did not include NEET-UG, and any 2027 date circulating online was a guess until the NTA issued a notice; the 2026 exam was held on 3 May and 21 June 2026.

capsules.subject: Biology
capsules.title: Nobel Medicine 2026: optogenetics — Deisseroth, Hegemann, Nagel (5 Oct)
capsules.body: The 2026 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine (announced 5 October 2026) was awarded to Karl Deisseroth (USA), Peter Hegemann and Georg Nagel (Germany) for discoveries concerning light-gated ion channels and the creation of optogenetics. Optogenetics combines light and genetics to switch neurons on and off in living brains using light-sensitive channels such as channelrhodopsin — opening a new field for unravelling how the brain works. For NEET: remember the trio, the term optogenetics, and that the channels are light-gated (ions flow when illuminated).

capsules.subject: Biology
capsules.title: CRS-35 brings health research to the ISS (13 Oct 2026)
capsules.body: SpaceX's CRS-35 mission (13 October 2026) carried over 6,300 pounds of cargo including experiments on vision restoration, heart tissue, brain disorders and a precision-health study of antibiotic-resistant bacteria in microgravity (its fourth and final planned ISS stay) — findings relevant to long-duration spaceflight and to superbugs on Earth.

capsules.subject: Environment
capsules.title: Big cat conservation: IBCA HQ opens in New Delhi (12 Oct 2026)
capsules.body: The International Big Cat Alliance — a treaty-based body for tiger, lion, leopard, snow leopard, cheetah, jaguar and puma — opened its headquarters at 55 Lodhi Estate, New Delhi, on 12 October 2026. Approved by the Union Cabinet on 29 February 2024 with Rs 150 crore over five years, it has 29 member countries including India.

capsules.subject: Biology
capsules.title: Nobel Medicine 2026: optogenetics — controlling nerve cells with light
capsules.body: The 2026 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine went to Karl Deisseroth (USA), Peter Hegemann and Georg Nagel (Germany) for discoveries concerning light-gated ion channels. Their work created optogenetics, a technique that lets scientists switch individual nerve cells on or off using light — now a key research tool for neurological disorders such as Parkinson’s disease and epilepsy.

capsules.subject: Chemistry
capsules.title: Nobel Chemistry 2026: asymmetric synthesis — Kagan and Soai
capsules.body: Henri B. Kagan (France) and Kenso Soai (Japan) won the 2026 Nobel Prize in Chemistry for the discovery of non-linear effects and autocatalysis in asymmetric organic synthesis — methods that preferentially produce one mirror-image (enantiomer) of a molecule, crucial for making safe, effective drugs.

capsules.subject: Physics
capsules.title: Nobel Physics 2026: IceCube and astrophysical neutrinos
capsules.body: Francis Halzen won the 2026 Nobel Prize in Physics for decisive contributions to the IceCube Neutrino Observatory and the discovery of high-energy neutrinos of astrophysical origin — ghostly particles that travel across the universe carrying information from distant cosmic events.

capsules.subject: Space
capsules.title: Gaganyaan drogue parachute clears qualification load test
capsules.body: DRDO successfully conducted the qualification-level load test for the drogue parachute of the Gaganyaan programme at the Rail Track Rocket Sled (RTRS) facility of TBRL, Chandigarh, with ISRO’s Vikram Sarabhai Space Centre and ADRDE. The drogue parachute stabilises and slows the crew module at high altitude before main parachute deployment.

capsules.subject: Counselling
capsules.title: MCC NEET UG 2026 Stray Round: choice locking ends TODAY
capsules.body: The MCC NEET UG 2026 online stray vacancy round reached its final leg: registration closed 14 October 2026 (3 PM), and choice filling and choice locking close TODAY, 15 October 2026 (10 AM) at mcc.nic.in. Seat allotment processing runs 15-16 October, the allotment result comes on 17 October, and allotted candidates must report to colleges between 19 and 27 October 2026.

capsules.subject: Counselling
capsules.title: Uttarakhand NEET UG Round 3: document deadline 15 Oct
capsules.body: HNBUMU Dehradun released Round 3 allotment letters for Uttarakhand NEET UG 2026 state centralised counselling. Allotted MBBS/BDS candidates must upload documents by 15 October 2026 (5 PM) and complete reporting at the allotted college by 16 October 2026 (hnbumu.ac.in).

capsules.subject: Biology
capsules.title: NEET 2026 stray vacancy counselling started 13 Oct 2026
capsules.body: NEET 2026 counselling for the stray vacancy round started on 13 October 2026. The 2026 cycle has been turbulent: the NEET-UG exam held on 3 May 2026 was cancelled by the NTA on 12 May amid paper-leak allegations, and a re-exam was held on 21 June 2026. Final answer keys and OMR sheets with recorded responses were released for candidates who appeared in the re-exam.

capsules.subject: Biology
capsules.title: Parliamentary panel (382nd report) recommends CBT, age caps, two-stage NEET (Oct 2026)
capsules.body: The parliamentary standing committee on education, in its 382nd report (chaired by Mukul Wasnik) presented in October 2026, recommended a sweeping NTA overhaul after NEET-UG 2026 had to be cancelled despite biometric checks, mobile jammers and AI-monitored CCTV: a shift to computer-based testing, exploring reasonable age and attempt caps (candidates above 70 appeared for NEET-UG), a two-stage medical entrance format, regulation of the coaching industry, and 1,000 secure government-owned test centres by 2030, at least one in every district.

capsules.subject: Biology
capsules.title: Centre building national CBT infrastructure strategy; NEET UG 2027 to be online (30 Sep 2026)
capsules.body: The Ministry of Education is formulating a national examination-grade computer-based testing infrastructure strategy to enable the shift of NEET from pen-and-paper to online mode, officials said on 30 September 2026, with the final decision awaiting the report of a high-level task force led by Infosys co-founder Nandan Nilekani. It has already been announced that NEET UG 2027 will be conducted in CBT mode.

capsules.subject: Science
capsules.title: IIT Madras brain-mapping centre in focus: PM visits Sudha Gopalakrishnan Brain Centre (14 Oct 2026)
capsules.body: Prime Minister Narendra Modi visited the Sudha Gopalakrishnan Brain Centre at IIT Madras, which is working on mapping the human brain at the cellular level — research relevant to neuroscience, neurodegenerative diseases and brain-inspired computing. (Dated: 14 Oct 2026)

capsules.subject: Health
capsules.title: WHO urges countries to strengthen action against lead exposure (16 Oct 2026)
capsules.body: The World Health Organization called on countries to bolster efforts to prevent lead exposure, which has affected hundreds of millions of children worldwide — a reminder that lead is a cumulative toxicant affecting the nervous system, with no known safe blood-lead level in children. (Dated: 16 Oct 2026)

capsules.subject: NEET updates
capsules.title: SC seeks Centre's reply on NEET-PG 2026 answer key transparency
capsules.body: The Supreme Court on 15 October 2026 sought a response from the Centre on a plea seeking transparency in the answer key and response disclosure process for NEET-PG 2026 — an important development for medical aspirants tracking the exam's procedural safeguards.

capsules.subject: Ayurveda
capsules.title: KAUMARACON 2026: Ayurveda paediatrics goes global
capsules.body: The All India Institute of Ayurveda (AIIA), under the Ministry of Ayush, hosted KAUMARACON 2026 — an International Conference on Ayurveda Paediatrics — in New Delhi on 15-16 October 2026, with clinical researchers from 14 nations formulating standardised Ayurvedic paediatric protocols for developmental delays, childhood malnutrition and immunity enhancement (Swarnaprashana).

capsules.subject: Health
capsules.title: WHO urges stronger action against lead exposure
capsules.body: The World Health Organization on 15 October 2026 urged countries to bolster efforts to prevent lead exposure, which has affected hundreds of millions of children worldwide — a priority public-health area for NEET aspirants' preventive-medicine preparation.

capsules.subject: Zoology
capsules.title: NEET UG 2026 Stray Round allotment result due 19 Oct
capsules.body: The NEET UG 2026 Stray Vacancy Round allotment result is scheduled for 19 October 2026. Candidates should check the MCC/admission portal and be ready with original documents for reporting to the allotted college within the stipulated window.

capsules.subject: Botany
capsules.title: NEET UG 2026: Aadhaar eKYC and live photo capture made mandatory
capsules.body: For NEET UG 2026, NTA introduced mandatory Aadhaar-based eKYC (Aadhaar-linked mobile number required for OTP verification) and live photograph capture during registration — face covering 80% of the frame, no caps, goggles or tinted spectacles. NEET UG 2026 was held on 3 May 2026 in pen-and-paper mode, 2–5 PM, as the sole gateway for MBBS/BDS/AYUSH/BVSc admissions. Separately, the Supreme Court has asked the Centre to explain the decision to lower the NEET-PG qualifying cut-off percentiles for 2025-26.

capsules.subject: Zoology
capsules.title: NEET UG 2027: not in the December–March NTA calendar
capsules.body: NTA's examination calendar up to March 2027 does not include NEET UG 2027. Going by the usual pattern, the exam is expected in May 2027, with the notification around February–March 2027 on neet.nta.nic.in — treat all circulating dates as unconfirmed until NTA notifies.

capsules.subject: Botany
capsules.title: NCERT-first: the Biology edge
capsules.body: For NEET Biology, NCERT line-by-line mastery remains the highest-yield strategy — the large majority of questions trace directly to NCERT statements, diagrams and tables. Read both Class 11 and 12 texts actively, then test recall chapter-wise.

capsules.subject: Chemistry
capsules.title: Physical Chemistry: formula fluency wins
capsules.body: NEET Physical Chemistry rewards formula fluency under time pressure: mole concept, thermodynamics, equilibrium, electrochemistry and kinetics. Practise numerical sets in timed 45-minute blocks to build the speed the single-day paper demands.

capsules.subject: Physics
capsules.title: NEET Physics: prioritise high-weightage mechanics
capsules.body: Mechanics, electrodynamics and optics together dominate NEET Physics. Master vectors, rotational motion, current electricity and ray optics with previous-year questions before spreading effort to lower-weightage chapters.

capsules.subject: Current Affairs
capsules.title: Parliamentary panel proposes two-tier NEET UG and statutory NTA accountability (Oct 2026)
capsules.body: The Parliamentary Committee on Education, Women, Children, Youth and Sports has advised the National Testing Agency to replace the single-stage NEET UG — currently one screening test for over 22 lakh candidates across MBBS, BDS, nursing and AYUSH — with a two-tier model comprising a unified preliminary test and course-specific mains, drawing parallels with the Civil Services Examination. The committee also urged a formal statutory framework making the NTA directly accountable to Parliament, stating that public confidence in national examinations is central to social justice (11 October 2026).

capsules.subject: Current Affairs
capsules.title: NEET UG to move to computer-based testing from 2027
capsules.body: The Union Education Minister announced in May 2026 that NEET UG would move from pen-and-paper testing to a computer-based format from 2027, in the wake of the paper-leak controversy and the overhaul of the NTA and India's public examination system. The Centre is working on a nationwide exam-grade CBT infrastructure strategy addressing test-centre availability, standardised specifications and multi-model sourcing, while awaiting the recommendations of a high-level task force headed by Infosys co-founder Nandan Nilekani, which has consulted former ISRO chairman K. Radhakrishnan.

capsules.subject: Current Affairs
capsules.title: NEET UG 2027: dates and pattern at a glance
capsules.body: The NTA released the NEET UG 2027 notification on 13 October 2026. Online applications run 13 October-15 November 2026 exclusively at neet.nta.nic.in. The examination is expected in May 2027 in offline (pen-and-paper/OMR) mode. Pattern: 720 marks, 200 questions (180 to be attempted), 3 hours 20 minutes, covering Physics, Chemistry, Botany and Zoology. Eligibility: Class 12 with Physics, Chemistry and Biology/Biotechnology; minimum 50% marks for General category; minimum age 17 years as on 31 December 2027. NEET UG is the single gateway for MBBS, BDS, AYUSH (BAMS/BSMS/BUMS/BHMS), B.VSc and AH, and BSc Nursing admissions.

capsules.subject: NEET Updates
capsules.title: MCC (13 Oct 2026): NEET UG 2026 cutoff-reduction notice is FAKE — only mcc.nic.in is authentic
capsules.body: The Medical Counselling Committee (MCC) issued a notice on 13 October 2026 declaring FAKE a public notice dated 12 October 2026 that claimed the NEET UG 2026 counselling qualifying percentile had been reduced (to the 15th percentile for General/EWS and 10th for reserved categories). MCC clarified that no such decision of percentile reduction has been taken by the competent authority, that MCC hosts no website other than www.mcc.nic.in, and that candidates should rely only on official sources and report fraudulent websites/agents immediately.

capsules.title: NEET UG 2026 stray vacancy round: allotment declared 19 Oct; reporting till 26 Oct

capsules.title: NEET-MDS 2026 cutoff lowered by 20.576 percentile points (General/EWS: 308 to 234)
capsules.body: The qualifying cutoff for NEET-MDS 2026 has been reduced by 20.576 percentile points across categories (NBEMS notice, on communication from the Union Health Ministry) amid vacant PG dental seats for a second consecutive year: General/EWS from 308 to 234 out of 960; General-PwBD from 289 to 218; SC/ST/OBC from 271 to 200. capsules.subject: NEET Updates
capsules.title: NMC grants one-time mercy attempt to eligible MBBS students (notice 15 Oct 2026)
capsules.body: The National Medical Commission approved (notice dated 15 October 2026) one additional attempt for eligible MBBS students admitted from the 2019-20 academic year onwards to clear the First Professional MBBS Examination — described as a one-time transitional relaxation for students affected by the COVID-19 period and related examination rules, not a blanket additional attempt for every MBBS student. The existing maximum period of 10 years for completing the MBBS course is unchanged. Students must check the NMC notification and their medical college for eligibility.

capsules.subject: Counselling
capsules.title: MCC flags as fake the 'notice' claiming NEET UG counselling percentile cut
capsules.body: 21 Oct 2026. On 13 October 2026 the Medical Counselling Committee (MCC) declared fake a circulating 'notice' dated 12.10.2026 that claimed the NEET UG counselling cut-off percentile had been reduced to the 15th percentile. MCC reiterated that it hosts no website other than mcc.nic.in and that counselling information on its own website alone should be treated as authentic. Exam angle: always verify counselling notices only at mcc.nic.in.

capsules.subject: NEET Updates
capsules.title: Panel proposes two-tier NEET-UG; NEET 2027 planned in CBT mode
capsules.body: 21 Oct 2026. A parliamentary panel has proposed restructuring NEET-UG into a two-tier model - a common preliminary screening test followed by course-specific mains - and making the NTA directly accountable to Parliament. Separately, former Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan has said NEET UG 2027 will be conducted in CBT (computer-based) mode, with a phased transition backed by government-owned test centres. Exam angle: education-policy current affairs for the exam-info section.

capsules.subject: Physics
capsules.title: RRI: accretion disk found around X-ray pulsar Centaurus X-3 (21 Oct 2026)
capsules.body:
21 Oct 2026 (DST statement): Raman Research Institute scientists led by Kinjal Roy discovered that Centaurus X-3 — one of the brightest X-ray pulsars — accretes matter through an accretion disk, rare behaviour for its class.

Centaurus X-3 is a high-mass X-ray binary (HMXB) ~24,000 light years away; the companion exceeds 10 solar masses. A neutron star packs a sun's mass into a ball the size of a city — extreme gravity pulls the companion's ejected material in, emitting X-rays.

capsules.subject: Physics
capsules.title: Japan's MMX launches to Phobos; samples back by 2031 (20 Oct 2026)
capsules.body:
20 Oct 2026: Japan's MMX (Martian Moons eXploration) mission launched on an H3 rocket from Tanegashima — a 5-year, $578-million mission to land the French-German rover Idefix on Phobos (22 km across, potato-shaped) and return samples to Earth by 2031.

No spacecraft has ever landed on Phobos or Deimos; no Mars-moon samples have ever been returned. Phobos's origin (captured asteroid vs impact debris) is a key open question.

capsules.subject: Physics
capsules.title: Engine of Kepler's most powerful stellar flares decoded (Oct 2026)
capsules.body:
Astronomers (arXiv, Oct 2026 — Kővári et al.) found the engine behind the most powerful stellar flares in the Kepler field: in the binary KIC 2852961, a red giant spun up by its companion stays rapidly rotating and becomes the field's most magnetically active giant.

NEET physics link: magnetic reconnection, stellar rotation–activity relation, and space weather beyond the Sun — flares release energy as EM radiation across the spectrum.

capsules.subject: Biology
capsules.title: SC: internet access a fundamental right for children (15 Oct 2026)
capsules.body:
21 Oct 2026: The SC declared internet access a fundamental right under Article 21 + 19(1)(a) — extending to children (Just Rights for Children Alliance v. S. Harish, 2026 INSC 1149).

NEET biology link: the judgment's CSEAM (child sexual exploitation material) directions touch adolescent health, mental-health safeguards and digital wellbeing — themes in human health and disease units.

capsules.subject: General Awareness
capsules.title: NTA to launch AI helpline for JEE/NEET/CUET aspirants
capsules.body: The National Testing Agency has decided to roll out an AI-powered helpline to address candidates' queries on applications for entrance exams like JEE Main and NEET UG. The toll-free number 1800 180 47 47 is being repurposed for the service, which is currently being tested. It will give instant assistance on registration, form filling, documents, fee submission, eligibility and examination procedure. (Dated: 22 Oct 2026)

capsules.subject: General Awareness
capsules.title: Panel moots exam-paper overhaul: concepts over coaching tricks
capsules.body: A parliamentary committee report (12 October 2026) urged that NEET-UG, JEE (Main) and CUET papers test conceptual understanding based on the official school curriculum rather than rewarding pattern-recognition drills that feed the coaching industry. It also recommended a National Registry of Blacklisted Examination Vendors and a regulatory framework for coaching centres covering fee transparency, safety standards and student mental health. (Dated: 22 Oct 2026)
